subject: maths

concepts.title: Sum of Exterior Angles of a Polygon
concepts.definition: Walk once around any convex figure turning at each corner: the outside turns you make total 360 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: One full lap of outside turns always adds up to a complete circle of degrees.
question_patterns: find the missing exterior angle x of a polygon
calculate the unknown exterior angle when remaining exterior angles are given
what is the value of x in the exterior angles figure
determine the unknown angle x from given exterior angles
Three outside turns measure 100, 130 and x -- find x.

solution_steps.explain: add every known outside turn together
total exterior angle sum is 360 degrees

concepts.title: Exterior Angle of a Regular Polygon
concepts.definition: For a straight-sided figure with matching sides and corners, one outside turn measures 360 / n.
concepts.key_idea: Split a full circle into n equal outside turns: 360 / n each.
question_patterns: find the measure of each exterior angle of a regular polygon of n sides
calculate each exterior angle of a regular polygon with n sides
what is the exterior angle measure of a regular n-gon
determine each exterior angle for a regular polygon
Each outside turn of a regular hexagon measures how much?

solution_steps.explain: each exterior angle equals 360 degrees divided by total number of sides n

concepts.title: Number of Sides of a Regular Polygon from Exterior Angle
concepts.definition: The total number of sides in a regular polygon equals 360 degrees divided by the measure of a single exterior angle.
concepts.key_idea: One outside turn splits 360 degrees, so the quotient gives the side count.
question_patterns: find the number of sides of a regular polygon whose each exterior angle is given
how many sides does a regular polygon have if measure of exterior angle is given
calculate the number of sides of a regular polygon from its exterior angle
determine total sides of a regular polygon given exterior angle measure
A regular figure has outside turns of 24 degrees -- how many sides?

solution_steps.explain: number of sides equals total exterior sum 360 divided by one exterior angle

concepts.title: Number of Sides of a Regular Polygon from Interior Angle
concepts.definition: A corner and its neighbouring outside turn pair to a straight line: subtract the corner from 180, then divide 360 by the result.
concepts.key_idea: Subtract interior angle from 180 to get exterior angle, then divide 360 by it.
question_patterns: how many sides does a regular polygon have if each interior angle is given
find the number of sides of a regular polygon given its interior angle
calculate side count of a regular polygon from interior angle
determine number of sides when interior angle measure is known
Each inside corner measures 150 degrees -- find the side count.

solution_steps.explain: interior and exterior angles form a linear pair and sum to 180 degrees
divide 360 degrees by the calculated exterior angle

concepts.title: Perimeter of a Parallelogram
concepts.definition: A parallelogram has equal opposite sides, so its perimeter is double the sum of two adjacent side lengths.
concepts.key_idea: Matching across-sides let you add the two adjacent measures and double.
question_patterns: find the perimeter of a parallelogram given adjacent side lengths
calculate perimeter of parallelogram with sides length and breadth
what is the perimeter of a parallelogram
determine the perimeter of a parallelogram given two adjacent sides
Find the perimeter when adjacent sides are 8 cm and 5 cm.

solution_steps.explain: sum the lengths of the two given adjacent sides
perimeter is double the sum of adjacent sides

concepts.title: Opposite and Adjacent Angles of a Parallelogram
concepts.definition: Facing corners match in measure; next-door corners always pair to a straight line (180 degrees).
concepts.key_idea: Next-door corners sum to 180; facing corners repeat the same measure.
question_patterns: find all remaining angles of a parallelogram given one angle

solution_steps.explain: opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal
adjacent angles of a parallelogram are supplementary

concepts.title: Angles of a Parallelogram from Ratio of Adjacent Angles
concepts.definition: Given next-door corners in some ratio, split 180 degrees in that ratio to get both.
concepts.formula: angle_1 = 180 * ratio_a / (ratio_a + ratio_b); angle_2 = 180 * ratio_b / (ratio_a + ratio_b)
concepts.key_idea: Use the supplementary property (sum = 180 degrees) to partition angle measures according to the ratio.
question_patterns: measures of two adjacent angles of a parallelogram are in ratio finding each angle

solution_steps.explain: add the terms of the ratio
divide 180 degrees by the sum of ratio parts
multiply first ratio term by unit value
multiply second ratio term by unit value

concepts.title: Diagonals of a Parallelogram
concepts.definition: The corner-to-corner pieces of any parallelogram cut each other exactly in half where they cross.
concepts.key_idea: The crossing point sits midway along both pieces.
question_patterns: find half diagonal or full diagonal length of a parallelogram
calculate diagonal segment length in a parallelogram

determine diagonal measure using bisecting property of parallelogram

solution_steps.explain: diagonals bisect each other in a parallelogram

concepts.title: Diagonals and Sides of a Rhombus
concepts.definition: In a rhombus the four sides all match, and each corner-to-corner piece cuts the other at right angles through its midpoint.
concepts.key_idea: The halves of the two pieces, at 90 degrees, form legs of right triangles inside.
question_patterns: find side or diagonal segments of a rhombus
calculate bisected diagonal lengths in a rhombus
determine unknown lengths in a rhombus using diagonal properties
what are the segment lengths of diagonals in a rhombus

solution_steps.explain: diagonals bisect each other in a rhombus
diagonals bisect each other in a rhombus

concepts.title: Diagonals of a Rectangle
concepts.definition: A rectangle is the all-right-corner parallelogram, and its two corner-to-corner pieces match in measure.
concepts.key_idea: The two pieces measure the same and cut each other in half.
question_patterns: find unknown variable x from diagonal segments of a rectangle

solution_steps.explain: diagonals of a rectangle are equal and bisect each other, so their halves are equal
isolate x on one side of the equation

concepts.title: Classification and Properties of Special Quadrilaterals
concepts.definition: Quadrilaterals are classified into trapeziums, kites, parallelograms, rhombuses, rectangles, and squares based on side parallelism, side lengths, angle measures, and diagonal properties.
concepts.key_idea: Square inherits all properties of rectangle, rhombus, and parallelogram.
question_patterns: state whether the quadrilateral property statement is true or false

solution_steps.explain: check side equality, angle equality, and parallel pair requirements for the specific quadrilateral
check if diagonals are equal, perpendicular, or bisecting
